evals.prompt: /runner plans/login-frontend.plan.md 진입 후 새 plan을 처음부터 끝까지 실행해줘. plan은 3개 phase로 구성돼 있어.
evals.expected_output: Bootstrap 컨텍스트 인식, status 분기, worktree 생성, 단일 Agent 디스패치, stop-review와 dev-review 통과 후 사용자에게 병합 옵션 제시
expectations: Reads SKILL.md via Read tool when needed
Recognizes the [runner-skill bootstrap] context block emitted by UserPromptSubmit
Reads state JSON at plans/{plan_key}/.runner-state.json before acting
Routes to Step 2 when status=validating
Creates exactly one git worktree at state.worktree_path
Dispatches exactly one Agent call with subagent_type = state.owner_agent
Updates state.stop_review.armed=true and status=awaiting_stop_review before the dispatch
Ends turn after the agent returns so the Stop hook can fire
Invokes dev-review skill once status=awaiting_dev_review
Removes the worktree only after dev-review returns approved
Keeps HEAD on state.base_branch throughout the run

evals.prompt: /runner plans/login-frontend.plan.md 진입 후 stop-review가 BLOCK했어. status는 stop_review_blocked이고 last_block_excerpt도 컨텍스트에 있어. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: BLOCK 사유 인지 후 plan 에이전트 재디스패치(직접 코드 수정 금지). 자동 에스컬레이션은 없고 사용자가 매 BLOCK을 보고 직접 끊는다.
expectations: Recognizes status=stop_review_blocked from the bootstrap and reads the state JSON
Does NOT attempt to fix the code directly in the main session
Re-dispatches the same plan agent with the BLOCK reason as additional context
Skips re-arming because state.stop_review.armed already remains true after BLOCK

evals.prompt: /runner plans/login-frontend.plan.md 다시 입력. 이전에 dev-review에서 needs-change 2건이 나와서 멈췄어. status는 rework_in_progress, last_feedback_path도 컨텍스트에 있어.
evals.expected_output: feedback.json에서 rework_items[] 읽고 commit별로 reviewer가 지정한 dispatch_agent로 Agent를 디스패치, 완료 후 round 증가하여 dev-review 재진입
expectations: Recognizes status=rework_in_progress from the bootstrap
Reads last_feedback_path and parses rework_items[]
Dispatches one Agent call per rework_item using item.dispatch_agent (not the plan owner_agent)
Records the new feedback.json path via begin-rework before re-invoking dev-review skill
Re-enters dev-review with review_iteration matching the bumped round
Does NOT delete the worktree at this stage

evals.prompt: /runner를 입력했는데 plan 경로 인자가 없어. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: UserPromptSubmit hook이 차단해서 skill에는 도달하지 않거나, 도달했어도 bootstrap 부재를 인식하고 사용자에게 안내
expectations: Either does not run (hook blocked) or detects missing bootstrap and asks the user to re-invoke /runner with a plan path
Does NOT try to validate plan files manually
Does NOT create a worktree without a state file
